card.name: Words completing a set phrase
card.fires_on: Fires on a word that sits right before a fixed, predictable phrase ending, such as 'in' before 'paperback', 'renal function', or 'generally improve' before 'after'. Setting is book blurbs and drug-label text.

modes.label: Book format phrase
modes.description: The word 'in' just before 'paperback' in a book note.
modes.example: has just been published<< in>> paperback.

modes.label: Label wording
modes.description: Verbs or nouns in stock label sentences about kidney function or symptoms improving.
modes.example: Signs and symptoms generally<< improve>> after reduction in dose or discontinuation of

modes.label: Trial description
modes.description: Small words inside the phrase describing a trial setting.
modes.example: clinical trial in<< the>> first line treatment of patients with chronic lymph

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes words like abroad, overseas and trial, which suggest place or setting phrases.
card.plain: It lights up on a word that leads into a stock phrase, like 'published in paperback' or 'renal function'.
